z_composite_construction.formula: z_composite(i, t) = 0.818 × z_1715_pd27(i, t) + 0.182 × z_NEW(i, t)

z_composite_construction.z_NEW_source: per-sig_date scale(alpha) of alpha_scores_pd24.parquet (NEW Vol/Skew alpha)
z_composite_construction.missing_handling: If ticker present in only one alpha — its z is the actual z, the missing one is set 0 (no penalty / no bonus). Outer join.
z_composite_construction.pre_2001_07_handling: Option X1 — STRICT 2001-07 start (PD27 alpha first sig_date). 1999-01~2001-06 z_NEW solo window NOT included (정합 단순).

design_decisions_planned.top20_selection: setorder(merged, -composite_z) per sig_date, head(., 20) after liquidity filter

liquidity_filter.rule: K200==1 OR KQ150==1 AND ADV_20d (t-1) >= 2e8 KRW
liquidity_filter.lag: t-1 strict (PD20-b PIT-fix convention, PD26 verdict Method A)
liquidity_filter.frollmean: align='right' rolling 20d daily vol_value (Close × Vol), then take ADV at d_lag = d_now - 1

C_softmax.tau_selection: Adaptive: tau = median(|z_composite|) per sig_date (Boltzmann temperature analog) — typical value ~0.6-1.0
C_softmax.single_asset_cap_redistribute: iteratively cap at 0.20, redistribute excess proportionally
